name: @coboard/shared
_comment:exports: Development, Vite, Vitest and tsx consume the TypeScript source (the default). The production server runs compiled JS on Node 20, which cannot load .ts, so apps/server/Dockerfile starts it with `node --conditions=coboard-dist`, resolving this package to its tsc output in dist/. A custom condition name, not `production` or `node`, so no bundler ever picks it up by accident.
